definitions.gloss: writing on someone's behalf; ghost-writing; scrivener's work
definitions.explanation: The act of writing documents, letters, or other text for someone who cannot or does not wish to write it themselves. Historically, a common service for those who were illiterate or unfamiliar with official forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代書|だいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ask someone to write the documents for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{代書|だいしょ}{屋|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In the past, there were many scriveners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{代書|だいしょ}⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a time when scrivener's offices lined up near government offices.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to mean "to write on someone's behalf." {代書|だいしょ}{屋|や} (scrivener, document writer) was once a common profession near government offices, helping people fill out official forms and applications. The modern equivalent is the ⟦{行政書士|ぎょうせいしょし}→行政書士：08748_gyouseishoshi⟧ (administrative scrivener).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代書|だいしょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to write on someone's behalf)
- {代書|だいしょ}{屋|や} (scrivener, document writer)
- {代書|だいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask for writing assistance)
